items.body: An initial two-week ceasefire began; Israeli Lebanon strikes strained it that day.

items.label: 12–13 April
items.body: Islamabad Talks failed; the US imposed a blockade after Iran resumed its own.

items.label: 21 April
items.body: The United States announced an indefinite ceasefire.

slides.headline: Renewal Was Not Resolution
slides.subheadline: A memorandum and another ceasefire agreement preceded the reported collapse.

items.body: The US and Iran reportedly signed a memorandum lifting the dual blockade.
